rule: A product is not commercially ready until a member of the public can discover it, understand it, sign up, pay where applicable, receive access, use it, get support, and leave/export without manual intervention.
sellable_definition: Every revenue product must pass all applicable commercial gates. Free products must still pass signup, support, portability, privacy, security, onboarding and public-access gates.

payments.legal_merchant: IZAKHONO AFRICA (PTY) LTD trading as the relevant brand unless a separately verified legal merchant applies

public_address_rule: Every product must have a stable public web address. Temporary external hosting is acceptable only when reversible and clearly tracked toward an IZAKHONO-owned hostname.
limits_rule: Avoid artificial feature/message limits. Where compute, storage, abuse prevention or third-party cost creates a real constraint, expose a fair-use or capacity rule honestly rather than advertising literal unlimited access.
